calls.title: GrowthBook Demo for Kooba
calls.summary: Daniel Wathne (Sales) and Logan Bates (Solutions Engineering) demoed GrowthBook to Tom Gillan (UX designer at a Dublin web agency) who needs an A/B testing tool for client Water Wipes, comparing it to Optimizely and Convert. They discussed GrowthBook's visual editor, feature flags, SDK integration, metric analysis, and affordable pricing ($40/user/month), addressing Tom's pain point of needing a proper tool over a makeshift solution. Next steps: Daniel will send guides on the visual editor and implementation, and Tom will have his developer Thomas
